items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: a friend of mine, his name is Edmund Faucher... Edmund played with us a couple of times... he played with me.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's the bass player. Like Joe does, a lot of chords up there, right in the treble. That's right.

So I changed from one style to another, see? Uh, so right now, as I hear some numbers sometimes, I go out and I try them, I play them. But, uh, I mean, if I had to go out and play a game, all I would like to have would be a guitar and a bass, that's all. That's another. Now sometimes, the fella, a friend of mine, he's a carpenter, his name is Edmund Faucher, he's a musician too. Oh, yeah. You know, you heard him?
